A lot of this is insanely easy to achieve by not being desperate for a partner and learning to enjoy your own company and yourself (not in a narcissistic douchey way mind you). Once you learn to live life and enjoy it regardless of how many people are enjoying it with you, that natural confidence and air of content will be visible to others - and naturally it will attract people more likely to fit your standard, therefore increasing you chances of finding someone that fits your life goal.

This "woe is me" unlovable crap is the reason you can't find someone - it radiates off of you and permeates your moods and emotions making you either clingy, depressed, or both. Learn to enjoy being alive before trying to find someone to enjoy it with.
